info.description: Private personal research API. This service does not submit orders and is not investment advice. MAC-01 status is read from a local ledger; only its CLI runner can submit orders of at most $100 to the user's Alpaca Trading API account (paper, or live behind the runner's live gate). Paper swaps are simulated testnet fills priced from read-only market data. Only the paper-swap CLI records one. This API does not sign or broadcast. Authentication is not configured.
info.title: Veytrix API
